Name: Clint Cells Machine
Author: ashta1818
Description:
[ID]
Install dan Jalankan File/Mod ini agar Clint bisa menjual beberapa mesin di Tokonya. 
harga awalnya adalah 1200. Kamu bisa merubah harga item tersebut dengan hanya:
1. Buka file content.json pada folder mod
2. ubah harga sesuai dengan keinginan pada baris "price"

Tips: pasang mod di folder: steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods

[EN]
Install and run this file/mod so Clint can sell some of machines in his shop.
The starting price is 1200. You can change the price of these items by simply:
1. Open the content.json file in the mod folder.
2. Change the price to your liking in the "price" line.

Tip: Install the mod in the folder: steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods

Downloads.Description: Clint cell Machine in his store (keg, cheese press, seed maker, etc)
